Checked Oct 2, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host’s page before you go

How we know

The Hawaii Cycling Club’s weekly-rides page (undated, fetched Oct 2, 2026) lists a mountain bike ride every Friday at 4:00 pm from the Kulani Forest mountain bike park off Stainback Highway.

Hosted by
Hilo mountain bikers (listed by Hawaii Cycling Club)Community-run
Kind of ride
Mountain bike

For visitors

Casual meet-ups listed on the Hawaii Cycling Club’s weekly-rides page as a courtesy; the club says they are not club-organized and times and places can change. Check the club’s Facebook, Instagram or Strava.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 4:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Friday MTB at Kulani Forest group ride

Friday MTB at Kulani Forest is a mountain bike group ride in Hilo, HI. It rolls every Friday at 4:00 pm from Kulani Forest mountain bike park.

A Friday-afternoon mountain bike ride at the Kulani Forest bike park off Stainback Highway.

I’d like to say I ride for everyone else. I ride because it changed me.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, and every ride gets written down. The money goes through the orgs’ own rides. It never touches me.
